Important Note on Public Data License (Version 1.0) Regarding the Use of the Content on this Website and the Accounts

1.1.Source citation

  1. Users must cite the source when using the Content. The source should be cited in the following manner, with a clear indication of the original information provider and the relevant URL.

    If the URL can be used as a hyperlink, it is also acceptable to embed it in the relevant text instead of writing it out in parentheses.

    (Examples of citation):

    • Source: Official Website of the Prime Minister’s Office of Japan (URL of the relevant page), etc.
    • Source: “XX” (Official Website of the Prime Minister’s Office of Japan) (URL of the relevant page), etc.

  2. If users edit or modify the Content for use, they must indicate that the Content has been edited or modified, along with the name of the individual or organization responsible for the changes, in addition to the above source citation. Users must not publish or use the edited or modified Content in a manner that could mislead others into believing it was created by the Government of Japan (or a ministry or agency). This also applies to Content originally provided by local governments or other public institutions.

    (Examples of citation when using edited Content):

    • Created by editing “XX” (Official Website of the Prime Minister’s Office of Japan) (URL of the relevant page)
    • Created by Company “YY” based on “XX” (Official Website of the Prime Minister’s Office of Japan) (URL of the relevant page), etc.
    • Created by editing “XX” (Prime Minister’s Office X) (URL of the relevant page)
    • Created by Company “YY” based on “XX” (Prime Minister’s Office YouTube) (URL of the relevant page), etc.
1.4.Content to Which These Terms of Use Do Not Apply

These Terms of Use herein do not apply to the following content:

  1. Symbols, logos, or character designs that represent an organization or a specific project.
  2. Content that explicitly states the application of different terms of use, along with a clear explanation of specific and reasonable grounds.
